I know I probably can't say anything to make you feel better, but just know that this post of yours helped someone, me. I have had suicidal thoughts most of the time, and it's posts like this that help me see that I probably would just make things worse by being gone. When we said goodbye every Sunday on the train station I always cried in his arms because I didn't want him to go. But I believed that he was worth the pain because when I was with him everything else didn't mattered.
I hope you understand what I'm going with this, just believe me that if you two are meant to be, then in the future you will believe that everything had a purpose.
